notes.content:

First of all, I would like to express my sincere appreciation to all players who have been playing the game, and thank you very much for your valuable feedback and suggestions. These are all very precious for the growth of "Three Kingdoms: The Journey".

Here are some urgent bug fixes and optimizations I have made in the last two days:[h2][b]【Due to a bug that caused the first boss to one-shot characters after the update on the 21st, the version has been rolled back temporarily. The game will be updated again on the night of the 22nd】[/b][/h2]

3. Fixed a bug where the attack value of the attack intention was not displayed when the attack power was 0, instead of being displayed only when the final damage value was 0.
4. Implemented a new Flaw damage mechanism. When the enemy has Flaw, the final damage value is halved when attacked.
5. Reduced the spacing of the generals' roster to make it more prominent.
6. In the event, random card deletion will no longer remove the general's card!
7. Removed the "Next" button that appeared after players received all rewards in a level, and automatically entered the map to make the pace more compact.
8. Three-color silk bags can no longer be obtained repeatedly.
9. Fixed a bug where Gong Du's Flaw did not work.
10. Adjusted Dong Zhuo's health and some of his sacrifice effects.
11. Fixed a bug where discard cards such as Cao Cao could not be discarded when the number of cards in hand was less than the number of cards to be discarded.

I will try to update with more bug fixes and content optimizations at a frequency of every day or every other day. I have received all of your suggestions and recorded them one by one, step by step improving the game. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 《三国：归途》测试分支现已开启：孙坚阵营登场
notes.content:
大家好

今天给大家带来《三国：归途》的最新更新公告，感谢大家长久以来对我们的支持。为了能给大家带来更好的游戏体验，我们将在游戏正式更新之前先进行一轮测试，并根据测试情况对游戏内容进行调整优化。我们将会在优化妥当后将其推送至正式分支，以确保大家能有更好的游戏体验。

以下是本次新版更新内容：

一、	吴国阵营阵营登场
1、吴国孙坚阵营新增7名武将卡牌（孙坚、孙策、孙权、甘宁、吕蒙、周瑜、黄盖）
2、新增阵营军队卡牌11张（雇佣步兵、江东卫兵、庐江上甲、车下虎士、丹阳兵、解烦卫、雇佣弓兵、江东弓手、劫营骑射、横江武射、无难骑射、锦帆弩、雇佣骑兵、江东骑兵、劫营骑、无难骑、丹阳骑、解烦骑）

二、	全新核心机制：连击
1、吴国阵营新增核心机制“连击”，通过打出不同的武将及军队牌从而达成连击需求，完成全部连击需求后即可获得连击点。
2、吴国阵营的武将卡牌以及部分军队牌在使用时将消耗连击点数来代替指挥值。

其他新增内容：全新阵营专属装备

1、吴国阵营新增6个专属可升级装备，包括（古锭刀、霸王枪、两当铠、明光铠、白鸽、快航）

2、新增4个独特武将招募事件

3、新增4个全新的BUFF及DEBUFF。（双生、标记、水生、溺水）

4、新增12件全新战利品（直柄铜斧、襦铠、七弦琴、筒袖铠、幄帐、古铜甲、五福散、黄金锄、路鼓、铜甲胄、日晷、青龙刀）

[h1]如何开启【test测试】[/h1]

我们开放游戏的【test测试分支】是为了能够尽快地获取更多测试信息，同时也让焦急等待的各位朋友们能够提前体验到游戏的新内容，只需要跟随以下引导便可以将游戏切换至测试分支。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40854691/500198a7bc05dc028e5e9b2abaaee0ee76f03531.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] 选中你库中的“三国：归途”右键后点击属性。
[*] 在属性面板的左边点击选择测试版。

notes.title: EA 1.10 Patch note
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, long wait! Three months later, here comes the major updates. The specific contents are as follows:



[h1] high difficulty mode [/h1]

Now the game has added a new difficulty mode, which is divided into initial, simple, medium and difficult. Players can unlock the content of the next difficulty by passing through the previous difficulty. The new permanent buff [b] soul [/b] has been added to the difficulty above the initial level. They will appear on all enemies. With each additional difficulty, the types of souls will increase. Of course, the postwar rewards will be richer.



Initial: the default difficulty of the game, which is also the difficulty of the previous version of the game, without any "soul".

Simple: all enemies have a [b] 3 soul  at random [/b]

Medium: all enemies have  [b] 6 souls at random [/b]

Difficulty: all enemies have a [b] 9 soul at random [/b]



These soul buffs will exist with the appearance of enemies, and will be accompanied by a number. However, when the number of enemies on the scene meets this number, the soul buff will be activated. Therefore, please choose your strategic objectives carefully to defeat your enemies, otherwise these soul buffs will bring great pressure to the situation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40854691/80c64e8e0b8995899fe854b69352326651c34894.png[/img]


[h1] strategic materials [/h1]

Now you will be able to gain a new resource point: strategic materials by defeating the enemy, obtaining territory resources, customs clearance Games, etc.



This resource point can be used to upgrade your generals. Whether you are on the way home or completing the journey, you can get corresponding point rewards to prepare for the more difficult challenges in the future.



At the same time, you can get more points through the later stages of the level and higher difficulty!



[h1] general upgrade and customization [/h1]

You will find a new general selection interface when you start the game. You can use strategic materials here to upgrade and customize (1 out of 2) all the general abilities. In the current version, by unlocking the general ability, you can select the general you need to find through events in the previous version at the beginning of the game, and even unlock new gameplay!
